column3: A laptop costs £480. You pay £325. How much is left to pay?

A recipe serves 6 people. How many people do 4 recipes serve?
A car travels 75 km each hour. How far does it travel in 6 hours?
Three-fifths of a class of 30 are present. How many pupils are present?
A water tank holds 800 L. It contains 475 L. How much more will fill it?
A runner completes 15 laps of 400 m. How far does the runner travel?
A shop sells 245 pens on Monday and 368 on Tuesday. How many are sold?
